description: Returns a published wedding vendor by its slug, including services, descriptions, FAQs, ratings, photos and website links. The result states whether the description, services and FAQs were generated by Aisle from public information or supplied by the vendor, gives a price band only when the vendor supplied one, whether the vendor chose its category, and where the rating comes from.

slug.description: Unique slug identifying a published Aisle vendor.

name: get_vendor_details
title: Get Vendor Details
